findings.title: Claim names a volume it cannot bind to
findings.cause: PersistentVolumeClaim data names PersistentVolume kd-pv-reserved-elsewhere, which is reserved for claim kd-pv-reserved-elsewhere/old-data (Available), so it cannot bind

evidence.command: kubectl get pvc data -n kd-pv-reserved-elsewhere -o jsonpath='{.status.phase}'
kubectl get pvc data -n kd-pv-reserved-elsewhere -o jsonpath='{.spec.volumeName}'

evidence.what: PersistentVolume kd-pv-reserved-elsewhere is Available with claimRef kd-pv-reserved-elsewhere/old-data

findings.fix: If kd-pv-reserved-elsewhere/old-data is gone and its data is meant for this claim, clear the volume's claimRef (kubectl patch pv kd-pv-reserved-elsewhere --type=json -p '[{"op":"remove","path":"/spec/claimRef"}]'); otherwise point the claim at a free volume.
